title: Portal signal selection must be source-time monotonic, not driven by older large deltas
root_cause: The current Portal V2 monitoring.js condition newer||stronger lets an older high-magnitude delta overwrite a newer verified observation, causing stale advice despite correct source archive.
impact: Last observed market/KPI signal and CRO recommendation can regress in time when out-of-order ingestion arrives; customer exposure and conversion impact are not proven.
fix: Compare observed_at strictly before magnitude; use abs(delta) only on equal source time. Keep original tenant read-model and original provider/source records.
prevention_rule: Portal uses authorized tenant-scoped newest provider time first, fingerprint+source reference, original producer revision, consumer processed ACK, actual outcome. Never treat missing external data or the magnitude of old observations as current success.
evidence: Source file portal-v2/operating-system/monitoring.js on protected main 1f0f70183a2889aec335cb6437f9b0bd65490e18
Daily 2026-11-11 and 12 original SHA256 source manifests accepted by original #140, unproven 4 source categories remain incomplete
Protected admission correction: machine regression moved to canonical tests/brain-* path; original runtime regression remains intact.
outcome: Fix candidate; requires independent production portal browser readback, not evidence of user, CRO, lead or revenue improvement.
